title.narrative: Value Chain Development 2021-2025

description.narrative: IDH’s Value Chain Development (VCD) program takes a market-led approach to developing inclusive, sustainable, and commercially viable agricultural supply chains in Africa. Through partnering with premium buyers, IDH provides technical assistance and close business development support to small and medium enterprises (SMEs) and aggregators to strengthen their business operations (technically and operationally).
